FAQ

Is an AI receptionist good enough for a law firm?For after-hours coverage and first-pass intake, often yes. Smith.ai pairs AI with live receptionists. If you want a human on every call, Ruby and Abby Connect both offer that.
How much does a legal answering service cost?In our directory: Smith.ai from free (25 calls) or $150/mo, Abby Connect from $165/mo for 50 minutes and Ruby from $250/mo for 50 minutes.
What else helps a small law office?Website chat that collects intake after hours (Chatbase lists law offices as a fit) and invoicing software like FreshBooks or QuickBooks.
